title: Keep route matching after removing the inert router setting
goal: Remove PreferExactMatches when upgrading a Router, while preserving exact and parameterized routes and distinguishing static SSR from interactive routing.

selectionNotes: The .NET 10 PreferExactMatches setting is inert even when false; remove it without a replacement switch.
Static SSR endpoint selection and interactive Router navigation are separate checks; both preserve /stations/new and /stations/{Code}.

runtime.name: .NET

sdk.reason: Build net11.0 against matching reference/browser assets. Exact RC2 pin records the test baseline, not a universal exact installation requirement.

language.name: C#

packageAssets: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components and Components.Web from the matching shared/reference framework; locked Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105 browser files supplied by the measured Web SDK.

renderingModes: Interactive Server client Router navigation; prerender disabled to isolate the measured mode
prerequisites: Use net11.0 Web SDK, register Razor components/Interactive Server and map component endpoints/static assets with antiforgery.
The previous net10.0 comparison uses SDK 10.0.402, framework/browser assets 10.0.13 and C# 14; the current sample uses SDK/framework RC2 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105 / 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105.
constraints: The .NET 10 PreferExactMatches setting is inert even when false; remove it without a replacement switch.
Static SSR endpoint selection and interactive Router navigation are separate checks; both preserve /stations/new and /stations/{Code}.
ResourceAsset has the same optional second constructor parameter in both baselines. No independent asset feature or new one-argument CLR constructor is claimed.
stabilityLimitations: Stable supported replacement APIs already exist in .NET 10. Current execution uses .NET 11 RC2; GA reconciliation remains pending. No conditional older-target package route is advertised.
